title: Solution Architect, Process Intelligence
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
   

  

 The Solution Architect, Process Intelligence is the senior technical owner of Edwards Lifesciences’ enterprise Process Intelligence capability on the Celonis platform. This role has end‑to‑end technical accountability across both Celonis platform pillars: Process Mining (data integration, object‑centric data models, analytical assets, and execution solutions) and Celonis Process Management (Process Designer, Navigator, and the governed process repository). The architect defines the event log architecture, ERP data extraction strategy, pipeline reliability, platform administration, and the technical standards that enable scalable, accurate, and audit‑ready process insights. While Order‑to‑Cash (O2C) is the initial scope, the architecture is designed to extend across additional enterprise process domains including Procure‑to‑Pay, manufacturing operations, and Idea‑to‑Market. This role acts as the primary knowledge transfer recipient from the Celonis SI engagement (896 hours, ending September 2026\) and serves as the India‑side technical leader for the BPM execution team. Upon SI handover, this role leads the maintenance, evolution, and scaling of the Celonis platform independently.
   

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**
* Define and maintain the enterprise event log architecture, object‑centric data models (OCDM), Perspectives, and Knowledge Model that enable process mining, conformance analysis, variant detection, and KPI measurement across enterprise processes. Own the technical design decisions that determine how business objects, events, and relationships are modeled within the platform (25%).
* Own the end‑to‑end data integration strategy from source ERP systems (Oracle JDE) into the Celonis platform, including connector configuration, extraction method selection (JDBC, REST, batch vs. real‑time), transformation scripts (PQL), data integration scheduling, and pipeline orchestration. Ensure stable, performant, and governed data flows that meet SLA requirements (20%).
* Serve as the technical owner of the Celonis Process Management (CPM) environment, including Process Designer, Navigator, and the enterprise process repository. Manage platform administration including SSO configuration, user roles and permissions, Home Site configuration, and release cycle governance. Ensure the CPM environment is operationally ready for enterprise‑scale BPMN modeling and process catalog consumption (15%).
* Serve as the primary technical counterpart to the Celonis SI team during the implementation engagement (May–September 2026\). Lead knowledge transfer activities across all SOW phases (Connect, Data Ready, Analyze, Execute, Handover) and ensure internal capability is built to sustain, operate, and evolve the platform independently post‑engagement. Shadow SI consultants during OCDM configuration, Studio asset development, and Action Flow design (15%).
* Establish and govern the data quality framework — including validation rules, reconciliation procedures, data scorecards, and root‑cause resolution workflows — to ensure mining outputs are accurate, consistent, and audit‑ready. Define acceptance criteria for event logs and analytical assets before publication to business stakeholders (10%).
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Process Intelligence Data Engineer (P3\), Senior Analyst, Process Excellence (P3\), and broader Pune BPM execution team. Define technical standards, conduct architecture reviews, establish reusable templates and patterns, and ensure alignment with Edwards enterprise IT governance and security requirements (10%).
* Evaluate and recommend adoption paths for emerging Celonis capabilities (e.g., Process Sphere, Action Flows, AgentC, AI‑driven insights) aligned to Edwards’ process intelligence roadmap. Configure and validate execution solutions including Action Flows and Business Apps for prioritized value opportunities (5%).


**What you’ll need (Required):**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, solution architecture, or analytics platform architecture roles.
* Hands‑on experience with the Celonis platform, including data integration, PQL (Process Query Language), object‑centric data modeling, and Studio asset development.
* Strong expertise in SQL, relational database design, and ERP data schemas (Oracle JDE, SAP, or equivalent).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define data governance frameworks, quality standards, and architectural documentation.
* Experience with platform administration including SSO, user provisioning, and role‑based access control.
* Ability to lead technical delivery in a global, matrixed organization and serve as a technical mentor for colleagues with less experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
* High level of independence, sound judgment, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, greenfield environments.


**What else we look for (Preferred):**
* Celonis certification(s) such as Celonis Data Engineer, Celonis Analyst, or Celonis Solution Architect.
* Experience with Celonis Process Management (CPM/Symbio), including Process Designer and Navigator.
* Experience implementing Celonis from greenfield (not just operating an existing deployment).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS) and modern data stack tooling.
* Python or other scripting language proficiency for data automation, validation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Experience operating in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals) requiring data integrity, audit readiness, and SOX compliance.
* Familiarity with BPMN 2\.0 process modeling standards and process excellence methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Experience with Action Flows, Business Apps, or similar execution/automation solutions within process mining platforms.

title: AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**
* Build and govern eval suites — ground\-truth Q\&A sets, LLM\-as\-judge rubrics, frozen baselines — that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact.
* Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue\-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML.
* Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval\-threshold gates, red\-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals.
* Bring evaluation\-driven development practice into client engagements — showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one\-time audit.


**Own Presales and Client Proposals**
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure.
* Architect engagements across the full ladder — AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA — and fast\-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.
* Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client\-managed, risk\-reward and Zensar\-managed commercial models.


**Present and Articulate Value to Clients**
* Present the ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders — from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers — adapting the narrative to each audience.
* Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session.
* Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board\-ready.


**Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales**

* Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI\-specialist roles — Prompt Engineer, LLM\-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead.
* Support GenAI and AI\-enablement training for QI associates across the practice.

**Must\-Have**
* Approximately 17–21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands\-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering — automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle — not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background.

title: Architect - OT Security (Network Security)
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced OT Security Architect with strong expertise in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and Network Security to lead the design and implementation of secure, resilient, and compliant IT/OT/Cloud security architectures. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in protecting business\-critical operational environments by implementing Zero Trust principles, securing industrial networks, and ensuring compliance with industry standards such as IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, and ISO 27017\. This role requires deep technical expertise, architecture leadership, stakeholder engagement, and hands\-on experience in securing complex OT environments across energy, utilities, industrial automation, and cloud\-connected operational platforms.
 



  




* **Role: Architect \- OT Security (Network Security)**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Design and govern secure IT, OT, and cloud\-connected network architectures aligned with industry security standards and operational requirements.
* Develop and implement defense\-in\-depth security strategies for OT and ICS environments.
* Define network segmentation, VLANs, DMZ architectures, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure remote access controls.
* Lead Zero Trust security initiatives including ZTNA, MFA, PAM, and identity\-based access control implementation.
* Architect secure data flows between industrial systems, enterprise networks, cloud platforms, and remote operational environments.
* Design and implement secure cloud\-connected OT architectures leveraging AWS security services and controls.
* Establish architecture guardrails, security standards, hardening baselines, and implementation best practices.
* Conduct threat modeling, security assessments, risk reviews, and vulnerability management activities.
* Support compliance assessments against IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, ISO 27017, CRA, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Design and review industrial firewall, gateway, IDS/IPS, and network security solutions.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for network security, segmentation, VPN, firewall, DNS, routing, and access\-related issues.
* Secure and assess industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, and MQTT.
* Drive SIEM integration, monitoring, alert investigation, incident response, and security operations readiness.
* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, operations, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architecture governance, and customer\-facing security consulting.
* Present security risks, mitigation plans, and architectural recommendations to leadership and clients.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 10 to 15 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Network Security, OT Security, or Security Architecture roles.
* Strong expertise in OT/ICS security architecture and industrial network security design.
* Extensive experience implementing IEC 62443 security frameworks and defense\-in\-depth architectures.

title: Associate Director_3367
description:
**About The Job**
 The AI Factory is a central delivery unit at Allianz Technology that builds and deploys AI\-powered solutions across the Allianz Group. It runs four pillars, Personal Productivity, AI\-Native Ways of Working, Application Rebuild \& Modernization, and AI Use Case Delivery, on top of a shared AI platform ecosystem that provides the runtime, governance, observability, and reusable building blocks every solution runs on.
   

  

 The AI Factory Lead India will head the AI Factory's India team members in India: AI Engagement Managers who shape and steer OE engagements, Forward Deployed Engineers who build and ship the underlying solutions, and AI Platform Engineers who build and operate the shared AI platform every solution runs on. Together they turn OE and Group pain points into deliverable, funded AI projects through a defined lifecycle from Idea to Handover, backed by a growing library of reusable AI building blocks that turn one OE's solution into the next OE's head start. The AI Factory Lead India will also bridge the end\-to\-end delivery, setting priorities across concurrent engagements, growing and coaching AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers, and acting as the senior escalation point with AI Factory, Allianz Technology leadership, Heads of ITs', and Account Managers. The role balances demand shaping and delivery execution with platform health, and represents the India team within Allianz Technology's global AI Factory leadership.
   

  

**What You Do**
* Lead and grow the India AI Factory team \- AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers and other AI roles \- setting priorities across concurrent OE engagements.
* Coach and develop team members; manage workload distribution, performance, hiring, and career growth across all three disciplines.
* Own the Factory's India delivery portfolio: sequence engagements, resolve cross\-team resource conflicts, and ensure reusable patterns (MVS, AI Building Blocks, platform capabilities) flow between projects.
* Act as the senior escalation point and relationship owner with OE leadership, Heads of IT, and Account Managers, unblocking engagements Engagement Managers cannot resolve alone.
* Own the India team's overall demand pipeline; prioritize opportunities, allocate Engagement Managers, and balance qualification, delivery, and run\-support work across concurrent engagements.
* Represent the AI Factory in governance forums, portfolio reviews, and budget and resourcing conversations with senior stakeholders, up to CTO and Board level where required.
* Ensure the AI Platform Engineers' roadmap (runtime, governance, FinOps, observability) reflects needs surfaced by live engagements.
* Champion reuse: ensure Forward Deployed Engineers contribute new patterns back to the central building\-block catalogue and Engagement Managers factor reuse into scoping.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover model \- including support models, SLAs/OLAs, runbooks, and MLOps/monitoring \- and maintain oversight of security, compliance, and responsible\-AI standards across all Factory deliverables.
* Track Factory\-wide KPIs (time\-to\-value, reuse rate, delivery predictability, platform cost and reliability) and drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience leading multi\-disciplinary technical teams (delivery/engagement, engineering, and platform functions) in large, matrix organizations, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* People management track record: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development across senior technical and delivery roles.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to challenge scope and platform decisions honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience running a delivery portfolio: demand shaping, prioritization, resourcing, budget ownership, and risk management across concurrent engagements.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


 Not Expected To Hands\-on Build Or Hold Formal Certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) \- Working Knowledge Of The Following Is Needed To Guide Trade\-offs, Hold Credible Technical Conversations With The Team, And Challenge Or Support Architectural And Platform Decisions
   

  

* Enterprise and solution architecture concepts \- technical blueprints, reusable solution frameworks, AI reference architectures, and integration standards.
* GenAI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent assistants, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agents, and automation pipelines.
* Architecture patterns for multi\-system integration, API orchestration, and data harmonization.
* Cloud\-native platforms and services on at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* The modern AI/data stack \- vector databases, embedding stores, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM/agent framework integration.
* AI governance and responsible\-AI principles, including model governance, data lineage, and auditability.
* Solution lifecycle management and reuse practices (MVS, AI Building Blocks) across sandbox, standardization, and retirement stages.


**What We Offer**
* We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in\-person collaboration and remote working, including up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

 With its headquarters in Munich, Germany, Allianz Technology is Allianz's global IT service provider and delivers IT solutions that drive the group's digitalization. With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co\-create the best customer experience.
   

  

 We service the entire spectrum of digitalization, from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. In short: We deliver comprehensive end\-to\-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age. We are the backbone of Allianz. Find us at: www.linkedin.com/company/allianz\-technology.
   

  

**Commitment to Integrity, Fairness \& Inclusion**

title: Technical Lead - AI First Approach
description:
**Job: Technical Lead (AI\-First \| Strong Fundamentals \| MVP Builder)**




  





 At
 **Infotech.Works** 
 , we partner with startups and innovators to turn raw ideas into working products—fast. Our projects typically move from idea to deployment in
 **2–6 months** 
 , starting with rapid discovery and moving quickly into execution.
 



 We’re looking for a
 **Technical Lead** 
 who combines
 **deep engineering fundamentals** 
 with
 **AI\-powered speed** 
 —someone who can design solid systems, make the right architectural trade\-offs, and still ship fast.
 



 This role is for someone who can
 **think deeply and execute quickly** 
 .
 



  





**What You’ll Do**



* Translate business ideas into
 **robust technical architectures and system designs**
* Lead
 **discovery sessions** 
 and create structured solution blueprints
* Design and build
 **MVPs that are fast to launch but don’t collapse at scale**
* Make key decisions on:
* Data models
* System boundaries
* API contracts
* Performance trade\-offs
* Guide developers through
 **clean implementation, code quality, and design thinking**
* Introduce reusable patterns and
 **standardized architecture approaches**
* Use AI tools to accelerate development—
 **without compromising engineering quality**



  





**Core Requirement: Strong Engineering Fundamentals (Critical)**




 We are
 **not** 
 looking for surface\-level developers who rely only on AI.
 



 You must be strong in:
 



  





**Database Design** 



* Schema design (normalized vs denormalized)
* Indexing strategies and query optimization
* Handling large datasets and performance bottlenecks
* Designing for reporting, analytics, and scalability
* Writing efficient SQL and understanding execution plans



  





**System Design \& Architecture** 



* Designing scalable, modular, and maintainable systems
* Clear understanding of:
* Monolith vs microservices (and when NOT to over\-engineer)
* API design and contract\-first thinking
* Caching strategies, queues, background jobs
* Ability to design systems that evolve from
 **MVP → scale without rework**



  





**Problem Solving** 



* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into structured solutions
* Strong debugging and performance optimization skills



  





**AI\-First Mindset (Equally Important)** 




 You should actively use AI to
 **move faster** 
 , not to replace thinking.
 


* Daily use of tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor
* Ability to
 **learn new stacks quickly using AI\-assisted workflows**
* Comfortable integrating APIs like OpenAI API into products
* Use AI for:
* Rapid prototyping
* Debugging
* Code generation
* Architecture exploration



 The key difference:
 



 You
 **verify, refine, and improve AI output using strong fundamentals** 




  





**Experience Required**



* 7–10 years of software development experience
* Proven track record of
 **shipping multiple MVPs or products end\-to\-end**
* Experience in
 **startup, product studio, or consulting environments preferred**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead small teams



  





**Technology Expectations**




**Backend** 



* Laravel (PHP), Node.js (Express/Nest), or Python (Django/FastAPI)
* Strong API design and integration experience



**Frontend** 



* React / Next.js / Vue
* Ability to quickly build functional, usable interfaces



**Cloud \& DevOps** 



* AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, SES, CloudWatch)
* Docker, CI/CD, Git



**Databases** 



* Strong expertise in MySQL / PostgreSQL (must\-have)
* Exposure to NoSQL is a plus



  





**Who You Are**



* You understand
 **why things work** 
 , not just how to use them
* You can
 **design systems from scratch** 
 , not just assemble components
* You are comfortable with ambiguity but
 **bring structure quickly**
* You move fast—but
 **never compromise on core design quality**
* You use AI as a
 **multiplier** 
 , not a crutch



  





**Ideal Candidate Mindset**




 “I can design the system, optimize the database, and ship the product. AI helps me go faster—but I know what good engineering looks like.”

title: Planisware Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Planisware Architect
   

  

**Location: Pune, India**
**Company Overview**
**About SLB**
 SLB is the world's leading provider of technology for reservoir characterization, drilling, production, and processing to the oil and gas industry. Working in more than 85 countries and employing approximately 100,000 people who represent over 140 nationalities, SLB supplies the industry's most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production and integrated pore\-to\-pipeline solutions for hydrocarbon recovery that optimize reservoir performance. Visit www.slb.com for more information.
   

  

 We are a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.
   

  

**About SLB India Technology Center**
 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.
   

  

**About Role**
 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.
   

  

 This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.
* Obtain business requirements and use cases / user stories from Product and Service Delivery, Supply, Distribution and Operation Planning Domains for all enhancements. Validate all such requirements and articulate to the L3 teams
* Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business.
* Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues \& Cost.
* Governance \& Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance.
* Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary


 Release Management
   

  

* Assist the Technical Team in the design and development of the release management process
* Expertise in various PLW modules, including Oscar and PMGo modules.
* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
* Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 \+ years on Planisware.
* Planisware Certification – Specialist OR Expert
* 4\+ years in Change and Release Management
* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.
* Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA).
* Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc.


**Key competencies**
* In\-depth knowledge of the change management process working on the change and release module
* Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
* Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
* Good knowledge of Azure IaaS / PaaS
* Very good experience of version management.
* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
* Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle
* Preferred experience in Oil \& Gas industry (though not mandatory)


**Other Skills And Abilities**
* Self\-driven, Proactive, Systems Thinking
* Open to travel abroad and in India
* Comfortable working occasional extended hours demanded by emergency release
* Exposure to Performance Tuning (Tuning concepts \- indexes, segments, partitions, query tuning) of database systems would be an added advantage
* Works well with all personality types


**SLB as an employer**
 As a leading employer in our industry, SLB is proud to offer a highly competitive package of base and incentive compensation as well as a comprehensive benefits program designed to support the health, wellness and financial security of our employees and their families. title: Principal, Enterprise Arch
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.
   

  

**Knowledge / Skills**
* Previous or current hands\-on software development experience using modern application development frameworks such as Java/Spring, JavaScript/ReactJS, APIs, cloud\-native services, and engineering automation.
* Significant experience with enterprise architecture patterns, architecture governance, capability modeling, target\-state definition, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Hands on experience designing and building of cloud\-native architectures; preference using Azure, AWS, Tanzu, and/or Kubernetes
* Deep knowledge of API and microservice style architectures
* Experience shaping AI\-enabled architecture strategies, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, model lifecycle management, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and integration of AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI risk management, model governance, explainability, data privacy, security controls, regulatory considerations, and production observability for AI\-enabled systems.
* Experience using API Management Platforms and Storefronts (e.g. APIGEE, Software AG, etc)
* Experience using Kafka, Solace, and/or MQ for messaging/event streaming
* Deep knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and/or Zachman, with the ability to apply frameworks pragmatically across business, application, data, technology, security, cloud, and AI architecture domains.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, data platforms, metadata, data quality, lineage, and governance capabilities required to support analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale decisioning; e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Mongo, data lakehouse, and cloud data services.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, product\-oriented delivery, Github, GH Copilot, ADO Boards, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD (Actions), MLOps, LLMOps, and architecture\-as\-code practices.
* Experience with DevOps best practices and toolchain / pipeline automation, Azure DevOps and Atlassian Suite preferred
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and in particular, a broad and deep understanding of products and services provided by Northern Trust.
* Has an understanding of Global Engineering domains, enterprise platforms, software delivery practices, developer experience, cloud enablement, integration, data, security, and operational resiliency in a large financial services environment.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks and controls.


**Major Duties**
* Define enterprise architecture strategies and target\-state roadmaps that provide business value while reducing complexity, technical debt, operational risk, and duplicated capabilities.
* Mediate conflicting priorities to drive optimal solutions.
* Identify and escalate duplication of effort, functional and technical redundancy, and opportunities to reuse Global Engineering platforms, standards, and shared enterprise capabilities.
* Create reference architectures and reusable patterns for common archetypes, including web, microservice, mobile, third\-party platforms, cloud\-native services, data platforms, AI\-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
* Quickly build proof of concept prototypes with new technologies being researched.
* Establish AI architecture guardrails, responsible AI design patterns, model governance expectations, data readiness criteria, and production readiness standards for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with platform engineering, data, security, risk, and application teams to integrate AI capabilities safely into enterprise platforms and business processes.
* Enable the development organization by creating working examples
* Create cloud, platform, data, and AI\-related frameworks that embed non\-functional requirements, including resiliency, observability, security, privacy, performance, scalability, cost management, and operational supportability.
* Define cloud, platform engineering, DevSecOps, data, and AI delivery best practices for Global Engineering.
* Training technologists and provide project\-based consulting/expertise
* Liaise with Enterprise Architecture, Global Engineering, Security, Data, Risk, Infrastructure, and application delivery groups to align architecture direction and execution.
* Solve problems collaboratively.
* Act as a subject matter expert on technologies and trends in enterprise architecture, cloud, platform engineering, middleware, data, security, infrastructure, generative AI, and AI\-enabled automation.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 12\+ years of technology experience across application development, engineering, architecture, platform, data, cloud, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8\+ years of enterprise, solution, domain, or platform architecture experience, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and govern architecture decisions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI, data, automation, cloud, and platform architecture concepts to enterprise transformation, including responsible AI and AI governance considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s degree preferred


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
   

  

 Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture \& technology leadership for multiple Real\-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
   

  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design \& architecture excellence
* Contributes \& drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology \& implementation decisions including all non\-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability


 The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
   

  

* Design \& Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering \& Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency \& Platform Evolution
* Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions.
* Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services.
* Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums.
* Engineering Leadership \& Bar Raising
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making.
* Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence.
* Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.


**All About You**
 Experience \& Technical Expertise
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale.
* Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms.
* Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures.
* Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling.
* Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.


 Technology Breadth
   

  

* Strong background in enterprise backend development with hands\-on experience across object\-oriented \& functional programming languages \- Java/Spring, React, Angular, Erlang
* Experience working across multiple technology stacks and system layers (application, messaging, data, platform).
* Familiarity with cloud and containerized environments; ability to operate effectively across heterogeneous market deployments.
* Payments or financial services experience (e.g., real time processing, regulated environments) is a strong plus.


 Leadership \& Ways of Working
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through technical credibility.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making high impact technical decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on long term platform health, not just short term delivery.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: SVS Tech Lead
description:
Some careers have more impact than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Sub Value Stream Tech Lead.**
**The Opportunity**
 Group Functions Technology is a Global Function encompassing platforms that are vital to the bank’s operation. Our mission is to “ Enable, Protect and Delight ” HSBC’s global businesses.
   

  

 Within Group Functions Technology, Risk and Compliance Technology is building a real\-time decisioning capability that can evaluate transaction events, coordinate multiple detection techniques and select the right preventative action within strict sub\-second latency budgets. Sitting above HSBC's real\-time data feeds, the platform will orchestrate rules, machine\-learning models, graph capabilities, foundation models and approved bounded agent functions across real\-time, near\-real\-time and asynchronous execution tiers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Define and build HSBC’s real\-time decisioning and model\-orchestration platform for financial crime prevention
* Translate financial\-crime policy and customer\-outcome requirements into deterministic, explainable and auditable technical decisions
* Architect a resilient runtime that selects execution capabilities, sequences and parallelism and calibrates outputs into a traceable decision
* Engineer low\-latency, highly available distributed systems with explicit time budgets, fallbacks, circuit breakers and safe degradation
* Own the technical direction across model execution orchestration and decision strategy while keeping them as clearly separated platform capabilities
* Emphasize Java and Python, event\-driven architecture, Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes and cloud\-native engineering.
* Champion AI\-enabled engineering and an agentic SDLC by embedding approved AI coding assistants and autonomous engineering agents with human oversight, traceability and governance
* Partner with CIOs, business leaders, architects, model owners, risk management, cybersecurity and engineering teams across Risk and Compliance to deliver safely at scale
* Mentor engineer teams and share knowledge through production code, design reviews, reference implementations and cross\-team technical standards.
* Automate delivery and operation from the outset, including CI/CD, policy and model versioning, performance testing, failure injection, decision replay, rollback and controlled production releases.


**What you will need to succeed in the role** 
 :
   

  

* As a Senior Technologist you should have hands\-on engineering experience delivering critical production code and reference implementations
* Demonstrate deep mastery of Java or Python including high\-performance services, concurrency and distributed workflow or orchestration engines
* Proven experience in designing low\-latency distributed systems including API and event contracts, schema evolution, idempotency, back\-pressure, load shedding, timeouts, retries and graceful degradation
* Experience in cloud native engineering, Kakfa or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes
* Experienced and comfortable operating in a highly regulated environment and the security and control framework this necessitates.
* Ability to communicate technology ideas clearly to business / senior leaders
* Ability to build trusted relationship \& collaborate well beyond their immediate team (including model risk owners, architecture / platform / security / engineering teams, cross ‑ organization and at times external stakeholders / industry)


**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

* Proven ability to influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams without direct authority.

**Role Overview**

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.

* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.

Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise\-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud\-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities.**
 Cloud\-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads.
   

  

**Platform Hardening, Network \& Container Security**
* Implement and manage Kubernetes Network Policies for micro\-segmentation and least\-privilege communication.
* Configure and enforce OpenShift Security Context Constraints (SCCs) and Multi\-Category Security (MCS).
* Deploy and operate Container Security Operators for continuous vulnerability scanning of running pods and images.
* Build platform functionality for image scanning, signing, and policy enforcement Advanced Cluster Security for runtime threat detection, compliance monitoring, and network policy enforcement.
* Drive platform compliance with CIS benchmarks (Kubernetes and Linux), FIPS, and zero\-trust guidelines.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large\-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience: 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on building scalable distributed systems, cloud platforms, or security infrastructure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Cluster API (CAPI), NetworkPolicies, SCCs, MCS, and related security primitives.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability.
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), and kernel security modules.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* This role combines deep platform engineering with hands\-on security ownership. You will shape how NKP delivers secure, compliant, and production\-grade Kubernetes \+ storage capabilities at enterprise scale.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:** 
 GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* **Delivery toolchain:** 
 GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* **Integrations:** 
 ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

description:

 We are looking for a Solutions Architect who is the technical lead in our customerconversations: designing how fits a given environment, running evaluations andproof\-of\-value engagements, and making customer teams genuinely capable at operating anAI SOC.You will work directly with detection engineers, threat hunters, SOC leads and CISOs. This is a hands\-on individualcontributor role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead technical discovery: map available telemetry, retention, existing detectioncoverage and blind spots across a customer's estate.

* Own technical evaluations and POVs end to end: agree success criteria, build theenvironment, run the scenarios, present the results.
* Run detection coverage and telemetry\-gap analysis mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK, andturn customer scenarios and post\-incident retrospectives into concrete detection andhunt strategy.
* Configure the environment\-specific context that makes analytics precise: privilegedand VIP accounts, critical assets, approved regions and service principals, sanctionedtooling.
* Build SOAR and automation integrations that connect findings to thecustomer's response tooling, and support onboarding across connectors, data paths,authentication and multi\-tenant design.
* Run workshops and technical deep dives, and maintain the demo environments,reference architectures and scenario walkthroughs behind them.

**Qualifications** 




  




* 7\+ years in security operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response or security architecture, including customer\-facing or consulting experience.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Hands\-on background building and tuning detection content — you have written rules, measured how they performed, and improved them in production.
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK: technique mapping, coverage analysisand gap identification. Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS for AI and agent threats is a plus.

* Comfortable working in a startup environment with high ownership.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Background in an MSSP or with multi\-tenant, content\-centric security platforms.

* Detection\-as\-code experience: Git\-based workflows, CI/CD, versioned and testedcontent.

title: Lead Engineer - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing \& fulfilment and post\-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
   

  

 As an OMS Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the team building and supporting omni\-channel commerce capabilities. You will own technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, resilient, and aligned with the broader commerce platform strategy. Working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Owners and Retail Tech Teams, you will deliver scalable, resilient, and secure omni\-channel commerce capabilities. You will champion engineering best practices, code quality, observability, and continuous improvement across the team.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of Order Management capabilities including order orchestration, inventory availability, fulfilment, returns, and post\-purchase experiences.
* Own the technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions for OMS platforms and related integrations.
* Design and build scalable, resilient, API\-first and event\-driven services supporting omnichannel commerce use cases such as Click \& Collect (BOPIS), Ship\-from\-Store, Endless Aisle, and Delivery Promise. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Retail Technology, Supply Chain, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive integration of OMS with Commerce Platforms, ERP, WMS, Payments, Logistics, and Customer Service systems.
* Ensure inventory visibility, order processing, fulfilment, and returns workflows are accurate, reliable, and scalable across channels and regions.
* Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, secure development practices, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and promote best practices in microservices, cloud\-native architecture, observability, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
* Mentor and coach engineers, providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and hands\-on support for complex initiatives.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve developer productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and building Order Management capabilities using Java/Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks, including implementation, extension, integration, and customization of packaged or custom order management solutions.
* 3\+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team.
* Experience with enterprise order management platforms such as Fluent Commerce (preferred), IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo Commerce, or Salesforce OMS is highly desirable.
* Hands\-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production\-grade services.
* Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end order lifecycle, including order capture, sourcing, fulfilment, shipment, returns, exchanges, and post\-purchase processes.
* Proven experience customizing and extending OMS capabilities to support evolving business requirements, omnichannel fulfilment models, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong knowledge of omnichannel commerce operations, including Ship\-from\-Store (SFS), Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship\-to\-Store, Curbside Pickup, Endless Aisle, and associated order routing strategies.
* Solid understanding of inventory management, sourcing optimization, fulfilment orchestration, and order allocation concepts across stores, DCs, and third\-party fulfilment networks.
* Proven experience integrating OMS platforms with Commerce, WMS, ERP, POS, Payment, 3PL, Carrier, and Customer Service systems to enable end\-to\-end order visibility and orchestration.
* Experience designing OMS\-centric microservice architectures with clear domain boundaries across Order Management, Inventory, Sourcing, Fulfilment, Returns, and Customer Service capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience with Kafka or similar event\-streaming platforms for event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise\-scale system integrations.
* Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, and optimization of high\-throughput, business\-critical commerce platforms.
* Experience defining and implementing capacity planning, resiliency, and scaling strategies to support peak trading events and global commerce operations.
* Experience driving technical architecture, establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted engineering tools, coding agents, and LLM\-powered development workflows to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.
