 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Technical Architect \& Salesforce Manager** 
 to join our consulting team. In this hybrid role, you will act as a
 **billable Technical Architect** 
 on active client engagements—designing robust, scalable Salesforce solutions—while simultaneously
 **managing and mentoring a team** 
 of skilled Salesforce Developers to ensure technical excellence, professional growth, and successful project delivery.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills from a technology perspective, including a foundational understanding of how to leverage AI development tools to optimize delivery cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background. You are able to lead and motivate a team of highly capable individuals and help them meet their targets while enabling their growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Requirements**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, guiding delivery teams on the effective use of AI\-assisted tooling to maintain velocity and quality
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, encouraging the use of AI coding assistants to enforce best practices
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Ability to understand a project and debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to assist in interpreting logs and isolating bottlenecks
* From time\-to\-time, participate in activities such as technical landscape discovery, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Commerce Clouds, with a foundational familiarity with Salesforce's AI offerings (e.g., Agentforce)
* Understanding of systems architecture
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Lead a technical team and own customer and team engagement
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%
* Maintain a target billable utilisation aligned to the role
* 9\-15 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Maintain billable utilisation targets for your team
* Technical enablement of team members on the latest Salesforce products and processes, including upskilling on modern AI development tools and practices
* Working with global teams for delivery across geographies. We will need you to be flexible with your work hours
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Enterprise Architect - Enterprise AI Platform & Governance
description:
Job Title \-
 **Enterprise Architect \- Enterprise AI Platform \& Governance**
**Location:** 
 Kharadi, Pune, India.
   

  

**Life Unlimited.** 
 At Smith\+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.
   

  

**Smith\+Nephew is seeking an Enterprise Architect \- Enterprise AI Platform \& Governance to lead the enterprise\-wide AI architecture strategy, governance, standards and adoption roadmap.**
 This role will serve as the central architecture authority for Artificial Intelligence initiatives across the organisation, defining enterprise AI standards, Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication patterns, Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, integration architectures, security controls and enterprise deployment guidelines.
   

  

 The role will partner with business leaders, digital transformation teams, platform owners, cybersecurity, data teams and external technology partners to establish scalable, secure, compliant and reusable AI solutions. It will participate in the Architecture Review Board (ARB), govern AI technology decisions, lead platform evaluations and selection scoring, and provide templates, playbooks, reference architectures and roadmaps to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
**Enterprise AI Architecture \& Strategy**
* Define enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference architectures and target\-state roadmap.
* Create enterprise\-grade patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, orchestration, model integration and AI operations.
* Align AI strategy with cloud, data, cybersecurity, integration, enterprise architecture and digital transformation strategies.
* Provide guidance for enterprise deployments, including pilots, scale\-up, lifecycle management and adoption governance.


**AI Governance \& Architecture Review Board**
* Serve as the AI architecture authority in the ARB and provide design assurance for AI programmes.
* Define AI governance guardrails covering architecture, security, privacy, validation, compliance, responsible AI, monitoring and operational controls.
* Review AI solution designs to ensure alignment with enterprise standards, regulatory expectations and scalable deployment practices.
* Publish standards, reusable templates, checklists, decision records and architecture review packs for AI initiatives.


**Agent Architecture, MCP \& A2A Standards**
* Define enterprise standards for AI agent architecture, autonomous workflows and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Establish patterns for Agent\-to\-Agent communication, agent collaboration, ownership, security, observability and lifecycle management.
* Define enterprise adoption guidance for MCP, context brokering, tool integration, memory, retrieval and interoperability standards.
* Create reusable agent blueprints and integration patterns for enterprise systems and business processes.


**Enterprise AI Platform Selection \& Technology Evaluation**
* Lead AI platform assessments, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations and technology comparison exercises.
* Develop scoring frameworks and objective evaluation criteria for AI platform selection decisions.
* Assess GenAI, LLM, agentic AI, vector database, orchestration, prompt/model management, monitoring and AI engineering platforms.
* Recommend strategic platform investments based on architectural fit, scalability, security, compliance, cost, integration and enterprise readiness.


**AI Integration Architecture**
* Define integration standards connecting AI platforms with ERP, CRM, HR, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Data Lake, Analytics and enterprise applications.
* Establish API\-led, event\-driven, service\-oriented and agent\-enabled integration patterns.
* Govern data access patterns, semantic layers, retrieval frameworks, model connectors, observability and secure consumption of enterprise data.
* Ensure resilience, scalability, performance, security and auditability across AI integrations.


**Enterprise AI Delivery Enablement**
* Provide architecture templates, reference designs, standards, playbooks, scorecards and roadmap artifacts for AI programmes.
* Mentor solution architects, engineering teams, delivery leads and partners on enterprise AI best practices.
* Support AI portfolio planning, sequencing, dependency management and delivery governance.
* Drive global consistency and reuse across AI initiatives while enabling business agility.


**Skills:**
**Mindset \& Behaviors:**
* Exercises sound judgment and makes clear, timely decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations
* Applies critical thinking to interpret complex information, make sense of ambiguity, and guide clear action
* Demonstrates ethical reasoning and accountability in decision\-making and delivery
* Brings creativity and strategic imagination to reframe problems, explore opportunities, and shape new solutions
* Shows learning agility and adaptability in response to change, feedback, and new information.


**What will you need to be successful?**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.
* Licenses / Certifications: TOGAF, Azure AI, Azure Solutions Architect, Cloud Architecture, AI/ML Architecture or equivalent certifications preferred.
* Experience: 12\+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Strategy or related leadership roles.
* 5\+ years of experience leading large\-scale Enterprise AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI or digital transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience defining AI standards, architecture governance, technology roadmaps and reference architectures for global enterprises.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot ecosystem, AWS AI, Google AI or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with enterprise integration, data platforms, ERP/CRM ecosystems, security architecture and operational governance.
* Experience participating in Architecture Review Boards and leading platform evaluation or selection decisions.
* Experience in manufacturing and MedTech domains, including regulated product environments, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing operations and compliance\-driven technology delivery.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA transformation, integration and enterprise architecture, including ERP modernization, process standardization, data integration and AI\-enabled business process automation.
* Core Competencies:
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent; business capability modelling; technology strategy and roadmap planning.
* Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, vector databases, semantic search, AI agents, multi\-agent orchestration, MCP and A2A standards.
* API\-led, event\-driven, microservices, cloud\-native and enterprise integration architecture.
* Responsible AI, AI security, privacy, auditability, model governance, validation, observability and AI operations.
* Executive stakeholder engagement, technology decision\-making, influencing without authority, architecture governance and mentoring.


**You. Unlimited.**
 We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.
   

  

**Inclusion \+ Belonging** 
 \- Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving. Learn more about our Employee Inclusion Groups on our website https://www.smith\-nephew.com/
   

  

**Other reasons why you will love it here!**
* Your Future: Major Medical coverage \+ Policy exclusions and insurance non\-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
* Work/Life Balance: Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
* Your Wellbeing: Parents / Parents in Law’s Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave.
* Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)
* Training: Hands\-On, Team\-Customized, Mentorship
* Extra Perks: Free Cab Transport facility for all employees, One Time Meal provided to all employees as per shift. Night Shift Allowances.


 Stay connected by joining our Talent Community.
   

  

 We're more than just a company \- we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.
   

  

 Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into
 **You. Unlimited.** 
 , life, culture, and benefits at S\+N.
   

  

 Explore our website and learn more about our mission, our team, and the opportunities we offer.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.
* Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value\-added resellers, and regional technology partners.
* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**
* Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.
* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.
* Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.
* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.
* Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.
* Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.
* Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.
* Effectiveness of pre\-sales\-to\-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.
* Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.
* Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long\-term technical quality.


**Reports To:** 
 Manager, Customer Success Operations
   

  

**Global Technical Alignment:** 
 Director of Technical Delivery
   

  

**Regional Scope:** 
 APAC

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 Principal Architect role in a global enterprise environment responsible for shaping long term architecture strategy and guiding complex transformation programs using Enterprise Architect tooling and practices. The role involves hybrid work in a day shift collaborating with distributed teams to design scalable solutions that support core banking branch operations and improve customer and employee experiences across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive holistic enterprise architecture blueprints that align technology capabilities with long term business objectives ensuring that systems remain scalable secure and adaptable to evolving market demands.
* Define target state architectures for core banking and branch operations creating detailed models with Enterprise Architect tools that reduce complexity and improve operational efficiency across business units.
* Guide solution architects and engineering teams in translating enterprise architecture standards into practical implementation patterns enabling consistent delivery quality across hybrid work locations.
* Coordinate architecture governance forums that review critical initiatives applying standardized principles and patterns to mitigate risk and promote reuse of proven design assets.
* Evaluate proposed application and integration designs for alignment with enterprise roadmaps recommending improvements that enhance data integrity resilience and maintainability for day shift operations.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders in branch banking and account setup maintenance and closure processes to ensure that technology solutions directly support regulatory needs and customer service goals.
* Champion modernization initiatives that simplify legacy platforms rationalize application portfolios and introduce modular architectures that reduce long term cost of ownership.
* Develop architecture guidelines and reference models that help project teams make informed design decisions improving time to market for new features in a hybrid work model.
* Assess emerging technologies and industry trends relevant to financial services preparing evidence based recommendations that strengthen competitive advantage and societal trust in digital banking.
* Facilitate architecture reviews and design workshops that foster shared understanding of dependencies performance considerations and security controls across multidisciplinary teams.
* Monitor architecture compliance throughout project lifecycles using Enterprise Architect repositories and diagrams to track deviations and drive corrective action.
* Document end to end solution landscapes for key programs in core banking and branch operations providing clear traceability from business capabilities to applications and infrastructure components.
* Optimize collaboration patterns between architecture development and operations teams to support reliable day shift delivery without requiring travel while still enabling effective stakeholder engagement.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive experience using Enterprise Architect to model complex enterprise landscapes including business processes applications data and technology layers in large multinational environments.
* Bring deep background in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or similar structured methods applying them pragmatically to guide long term transformation roadmaps.
* Show practical exposure to branch banking domain areas including account setup maintenance and closure with clear understanding of compliance risk and customer journey considerations.
* Possess strong skills in documenting architecture decisions creating clear diagrams and presenting technical concepts to business and technology audiences in concise and accessible language.
* Exhibit ability to work effectively in hybrid models and distributed teams using collaborative tools and disciplined communication practices to maintain shared architectural understanding.
* Apply robust knowledge of integration patterns data management practices and security controls that are critical for reliable and trustworthy financial services platforms.

title: ServiceNow - Moveworks AI - Manger
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Manager**
 As part of our EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using ServiceNow platform. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Lead Architect with expertise in ServiceNow Implementation and specifically Moveworks AI to join the EYD GDS ServiceNow. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

 The architect designs and owns the “AI front door” experience for employees, where Moveworks acts as the primary conversational layer over ServiceNow processes.
   

  

 Ensure natural language requests raised in Teams/Slack/Employee Centre are accurately translated into governed ServiceNow workflows.
   

  

**Key focus areas**
* Designing intent\-to\-action mappings between Moveworks AI Assistant and ServiceNow (ITSM, HRSD)
* Structuring knowledge bases, service catalog items, and record producers to be AI\-consumable
* Reducing ticket intake by enabling autonomous resolution for L1/L2 use cases (passwords, access, FAQs)


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Performs Configuration/Customization of the ServiceNow system, including creation workflows
* Architecting end\-to\-end AI agents that combine:
+ Moveworks Reasoning Engine
+ ServiceNow workflows, approvals, and policies

* Defining when the AI resolves fully vs. hands off to human agents
* Designing reusable agent patterns (HR)
* Performs integrations and process automation using Orchestration, Web Services, Soap calls, etc.
* Load, manipulate and maintain data between ServiceNow and other systems as needed
* Gathers specifications from the business departments and delivers a product/release that meets the needs presented. Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Work with business liaison to generate dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors and reports as needed
* Must analyse and fully understand user stories and internal procedures to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the ServiceNow releases
* Own Architectural reviews, quality reviews and technical documentation
* Performs system and integration testing with sample and live data


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep understanding of Moveworks AI Assistant \& Enterprise Search
* Experience designing conversational flows that replace portals/forms
* 
* Hands\-on experience with Moveworks–ServiceNow integration architecture
* Authentication protocols such as IAM/Active Directory / LDAP or SiteMinder federation /Azure
* Integrating with internal and external applications and systems
* JavaScript, HTML, Angular JS and good web design practices
* Implementation experience on any of the following applications on ITSM, HRSD, Service Portal, Agentic AI, Gen AI.
* Disciplined Agile Delivery software release build/deploy processes


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 10\+ years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* ServiceNow CSA certification is mandatory, CIS\-HRSD is favourable


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about ServiceNow’s latest version’s features.

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

title: Technical Engineer - Process Intelligence
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
 Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long\-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
   

  

 For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
   

  

 © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Design, configure, test, and continuously improve enterprise process intelligence solutions and business process monitoring capabilities using Celonis EMS and related enterprise technologies.
   

  

 Support business transformation initiatives through IT changes, Agile DevOps delivery, and process optimization activities in line with global Information Technology (IT), enterprise architecture, and security standards to enable operational excellence, process transparency, and measurable business value.
   

  

 The role contributes to data\-driven decision making by translating business process requirements into scalable process mining solutions, dashboards, analytics, and actionable insights across global business functions.
   

  

* The Technical Engineer in IT Operations is responsible for translating business process requirements into detailed functional designs, Celonis stories, KPIs, dashboards, and EMS configurations in accordance with enterprise architecture and security standards. Working within projects, operational changes, and Agile DevOps teams, the Functional Engineer coordinates the preparation, review, execution, and testing of process mining solutions while ensuring high\-quality delivery and stakeholder alignment throughout the implementation lifecycle.


 The Technical Engineer actively collaborates with business process owners, implementation partners, and external consultants during the execution of enhancements and deployments. The role contributes to incident resolution, root cause analysis, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to strengthen operational performance and process transparency.
   

  

* The Functional Engineer in Application Delivery is responsible for leading enterprise\-wide process intelligence initiatives and defining scalable process mining solutions across business domains. The role drives strategic transformation programs, establishes governance standards, mentors team members, and partners with Architects and senior stakeholders to design advanced analytics, AI\-enabled process intelligence capabilities, and sustainable optimization roadmaps.


 The Functional Engineer oversees large\-scale implementations and complex operational changes together with strategic partners and cross\-functional teams. The role ensures quality execution, monitors delivery progress, governs testing and deployment activities, and leads continuous improvement, incident management, and process mining best practice adoption across the organization.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Functional Engineer with a strong background in process mining and a proven track record in designing \& implementing impactful process mining use cases. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in using Celonis to analyse, optimize, and transform key business operations, particularly within finance and supply chain functions.
   

  

 You will leverage Celonis Process Intelligence capabilities, AI\-driven insights, and Agentic Automation features to drive digital transformation initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, opportunities for potential savings, and developing advanced Celonis applications, dashboards, and intelligent workflows that enhance performance and achieve business objectives.
   

  

 The role will also contribute to the adoption of AI\-powered process optimization, predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and autonomous action orchestration across enterprise processes
   

  

**Key Activities**
**Story specification**
 Translate business process requirements into clear and detailed Celonis solution designs. Own and develop high\-quality stories and configuration specifications for Engineers, Developers, and implementation partners to translate into dashboards, process models, integrations, analytics, and EMS configurations including implementation proposals and deployment planning.
   

  

**Development \& delivery**
 Guide, coordinate, and oversee the preparation, implementation, and deployment of process intelligence solutions and related configurations. Ensure that all internal and external partners follow established standards including process documentation, governance controls, testing procedures, naming conventions, and architectural principles. Review, approve, and control the implementation of new enhancements, dashboards, KPIs, analytics models, and process mining capabilities across enterprise solutions.
   

  

 This results in sustainable, scalable, and business\-aligned solutions delivered in close collaboration with stakeholders, business process owners, and external service providers. Solutions are developed according to enterprise architecture and security standards, while changes are properly prepared, documented, validated, and implemented to deliver operational insights and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**Testing**
 Own and coordinate testing activities for Celonis stories, dashboards, process models, and integrations. Develop and maintain test scenarios, review test outcomes, support user acceptance testing, coordinate business sign\-off, and contribute to release planning and test management activities to ensure reliable and high\-quality deployments.
   

  

**Incident management**
 Perform functional and technical analysis of incidents, data quality issues, and process intelligence disruptions based on business impact and severity. Conduct root cause analysis, document findings, coordinate corrective actions, and oversee deployment of fixes to ensure timely and effective issue resolution and stable operational performance.
   

  

**Process management and improvement**
 Monitor and analyze the performance, adoption, and security of Celonis solutions and related enterprise applications against agreed service and business KPIs. Actively contribute to process optimization initiatives through dashboard development, operational insight visualization, automation, and advanced analytics. Maintain visibility of technical debt and collaborate closely with Domain Architects and delivery teams to continuously improve process intelligence capabilities, DevOps practices, and platform stability.
   

  

**Project support**
 Support project and program managers by taking ownership of process intelligence deliverables including requirements gathering, configurations, dashboards, analytics, testing, and deployment coordination. Define, plan, manage, and execute assigned activities in alignment with IT delivery leads and business stakeholders to ensure efficient realization of project objectives and transformation outcomes.
   

  

**Experience**
 Knowledge extends across complete process intelligence domains and related enterprise processes.
   

  

 Participates in complex transformation initiatives up to €500K and coordinates, reviews, and approves operational and technical solution changes.
   

  

 Acts as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by identifying optimization opportunities and translating them into process mining and analytics solutions.
   

  

 Communicates technical concepts and process insights effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Demonstrates strong understanding of Agile and DevOps delivery methodologies.
   

  

 Leads complex analytical assessments across multiple domains, identifies optimization opportunities, and evaluates implementation effort and business value realization.
   

  

 Initiates and implements process intelligence standards, governance procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives across functions.
   

  

 Translates business requirements into scalable process intelligence and optimization opportunities across related systems and functions.
   

  

 4–7 years of relevant experience leading process intelligence initiatives and cross\-functional optimization activities
   

  

 Relevant Bachelor or Master degree

Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment. For this reason we train and educate on the implications of our Unconscious Bias in order for our TA and hiring managers to be mindful of them and take corrective actions when applicable. In our organization, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

description:
Join us as a Solution Architect. At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future, we create it. As a Solution Architect you will support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**To be a successful Solution Architect, you should have experience with:**
* Excellent experience of delivering complex end\-to\-end solution designs as a Solution Architect.
* A specialist understanding of architectural principles, best practices, and modern design methods.
* Previous ability to simplify complex challenges, delivering clear and effective solution designs.
* Past hands\-on experience on Private and public cloud, API development, Microservices, Various Integration patterns and protocols is Must


**Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued**
* Experience designing solutions for mobile and internet\-facing customer servicing platforms, ideally within Financial Services or Banking.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and guide strategic thinking through technology innovation.
* Expertise in complex systems integration, with sound knowledge of implementation and integration challenges and their architectural implications.
* Knowledge of corporate banking is an additional advantage


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Engineering Team Lead
description:
**We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.** 




  





 Love Work. Love Life. Be You. \- is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
 



  





**What does Access offer you?** 




  





 We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Lead Software Engineer is a ‘50:50’ role. Half the time you are in the code — shipping production software, holding the technical bar and setting the standard the team follows. The other half you are leading the people, the process and the architecture — running a high\-performing engineering stream and developing the engineers within it.
 



  





 You’ll be joining a small, value\-aligned structure: up to two streams of four engineers each, with Product cover per stream. QA is owned by engineering — there is no handoff to a separate team, and that is by design.
 



  





 AI augmentation is a pre\-requisite for this role, not an optional extra. Access has invested in cutting\-edge AI tooling and we expect every engineer and leader to use AI pervasively to accelerate outcomes, raise quality, and shorten feedback loops. Lead Software Engineers are expected to model this behaviour, embed it into team standards and hold the bar for AI adoption across their streams. If you are not already working this way, you will need to get there fast.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Spend approximately half your time as a hands\-on engineer: writing, reviewing and shipping production code to the same standard you hold your team to.
* Own the technical direction of your stream — architecture decisions, technology choices, design patterns and code standards.
* Set and maintain the engineering quality bar: code review standards, test coverage expectations, CI/CD discipline, observability and security practice.
* Identify and address technical debt proactively, balancing pragmatism with the long\-term health of the codebase.
* Contribute to platform\-wide architectural decisions, feeding your stream’s experience and evidence back into broader engineering strategy.



  





**People Leadership** 



* Own the performance, development and wellbeing of up to eight engineers across your streams.
* Run regular 1:1s, set clear goals, and give direct, actionable feedback — both positive and developmental.
* Manage the full performance cycle for your engineers: goal setting, mid\-year reviews, end\-of\-year assessments and, where necessary, performance improvement plans.
* Identify growth opportunities for each engineer and actively create the conditions for them to progress.
* Hire well — contribute to recruitment, assess candidates rigorously, and take accountability for the quality of who joins your team.
* Model the behaviours and working practices you expect from the team, including AI adoption, communication standards and engineering discipline.



  





**Delivery \& Process** 



* Keep your streams delivering consistently — predictable throughput, low change failure rate, fast recovery when things go wrong.
* Own the engineering process within your streams: sprint ceremonies, planning quality, backlog health and cross\-team dependency management.
* Work closely with Product to balance feature delivery against technical investment, making the trade\-offs visible and explicit rather than absorbed silently.
* Remove blockers for your engineers — escalate where needed, resolve where you can, and protect the team’s ability to focus.
* Ensure incidents are handled well: fast triage, clear communication, thorough post\-mortems, and unique failures — the same class of incident should not recur.



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




  





**Technical** 



* Software owned by your streams meets reliability, latency and availability targets in production.
* Lead time for change trends downwards; deployment frequency trends upwards across your streams.
* Change failure rate stays under 15%; MTTR trends downwards.
* Critical and high security vulnerabilities patched within agreed SLAs (1 day / 14 days).
* AI tooling is a demonstrable, routine part of your workflow and embedded visibly in team standards.



  





**People** 



* Engineers in your streams have clear goals, regular feedback and a development plan they understand.
* Regrettable attrition is low; engineers in your streams are growing and progressing.
* Performance issues are identified early and managed directly, without escalation becoming the default.
* New hires reach productive contribution within an agreed onboarding window.



  





**Delivery** 



* Your streams deliver predictably against commitments made to Product and stakeholders.
* Failures are unique — the same defect or incident class does not recur.
* Technical debt is visible, prioritised and moving in the right direction.



  





**Skills, Knowledge, Experience \& Qualifications** 




  





**How We Work** 




 Before the tech stack, this is what working in the F\&B engineering team looks like. As a Lead Software Engineer you are expected to model these standards, not just meet them.
 


* AI tooling is your default starting point, not a fallback — Copilot, Claude Code, Devin, Cursor or equivalent are open before you write the first line.
* You use AI pervasively across the full development lifecycle: generating and reviewing code, writing tests, producing documentation, triaging incidents and researching unfamiliar domains.
* You can prompt effectively — you know how to get useful output, iterate on it, and critically evaluate what comes back rather than accepting it at face value.
* You treat AI\-generated code with the same scrutiny as code from a colleague — it gets reviewed, tested and owned by you.
* You actively embed AI working practices into your team — through standards, playbooks, code review culture and leading by example.
* You improve your AI working practices continuously and bring the team with you; this field moves fast and standing still is falling behind.
* Expect your interview process to include assessment on how you work with AI tooling — not just what you know without it. Come prepared to demonstrate your workflow, not just talk about it.



  





**Technical Foundation** 




 The fundamentals are non\-negotiable — your technical credibility is what earns the trust of your engineers.
 


* Strong commercial software engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems end\-to\-end.
* Clean code, automated testing and CI/CD discipline — you set the standard, which means you have to embody it.
* Comfortable across the stack — backend, frontend or full\-stack — able to review and contribute across the breadth of what your streams own.
* Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with cloud\-hosted databases in production.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and/or event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
* Experience making and communicating architectural decisions, including the trade\-offs involved.



  





**Leadership \& People** 



* Proven experience leading a software engineering team — setting direction, managing performance and developing engineers.
* Direct, honest and constructive communicator — comfortable giving difficult feedback and having conversations that matter.
* Able to manage competing priorities across engineering and people responsibilities without dropping either.
* Experience running engineering process — agile delivery, planning, retrospectives, incident management.
* Comfortable working asynchronously across distributed teams (UK and India).



  





**Technologies** 




 Access F\&B runs a broad and evolving tech stack. We care far more about solid fundamentals and the ability to learn than exact technology match.
 


* Java — present across several F\&B product areas.
* TypeScript / React — frontend and web\-based ordering and management interfaces.
* Azure — our primary cloud platform; experience with Azure\-native services (App Service, Service Bus, SQL, AKS, Key Vault) is valuable.
* AWS — also present across parts of the F\&B portfolio.



  





**Security \& Compliance** 



* Working knowledge of security fundamentals: auth and authorisation patterns, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and PII handling.
* Awareness of GDPR and UK GDPR as they apply to software systems handling guest and payment data.



  





**What are we all about?** 




  





 The Access Group is one of the largest UK\-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid\-sized organisations in commercial and non\-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
 



  





 With
 **over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence** 
 , we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access,
 **people are at the heart of everything we do** 
 . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role \- even if your experience doesn’t tick every box \- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
 



  





 We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**
 Multi\-Domain Telecom Solution Architecture, SNOC Tools \& Integration Interface Expertise: Demonstrated experience in telecom solution architecture and SNOC integration across RAN, Core, OSS, TX, IP, Enterprise, Cloud and VoLTE domains. Mandatory hands\-on understanding of TEMIP, NNMi, NPM, SevOne, UHC, Infiworx, UIM and APM, with the ability to map domain solutions, monitoring requirements and end\-to\-end data flows to the appropriate SNOC tools and integration interfaces including SNMP, REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus with minimum of 2 years of experience.
   

  

 Integration Interface \& Protocol Engineering: Strong mandatory technical expertise in REST API, Kafka, Webhook and Prometheus integrations, covering API authentication, TLS/SSL, payload and response validation, error handling, timeout and retry mechanisms, Kafka topics, partitions, offsets and consumer lag, Webhook acknowledgement and idempotency, and Prometheus exporters, metrics and PromQL. Proficiency in PCAP, logs, traces, MIB/OID and protocol\-level troubleshooting is required.
   

  

 End\-to\-End Fault, Performance \& RCA Engineering: Mandatory capability to troubleshoot end\-to\-end Fault and Performance flows from Network Element or Domain through EMS, interface, middleware and SNOC platforms to ITSM, including alarm generation, severity, mapping, raise and clear, correlation, duplicate, missing and delayed events and ticket flow. Must be able to troubleshoot Bulkstat, KPI, API, Kafka and Prometheus performance flows, perform source\-to\-SNOC reconciliation and isolate failures across source, interface, processing and SNOC layers with evidence\-based technical RCA.
   

  

 Project Integration Management: Lead SNOC integration from requirement intake, solution assessment and scope finalization through testing, Go\-Live and HOTO
   

  

 SNOC Integration Strategy \& Planning Leadership: Define end\-to\-end integration strategy, scope, milestones, dependencies, prerequisites and execution plan for new projects and products.
   

  

 Solution \& Integration Architecture: Analyze OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational model to determine the right SNOC integration approach.
   

  

 End\-to\-End Monitoring Architecture: Ensure monitoring coverage for Hardware, Storage, OS, Application, Network, Services, Processes, Faults, Performance and Logs.
   

  

 OEM Solution Assessment: Understand and technically evaluate OEM architecture, components, interfaces, data flows and operational workflows before finalizing the integration approach.
   

  

 Solution\-to\-SNOC Mapping: Map OEM solution architecture against SNOC tool capabilities and determine the right integration points, monitoring platforms and operational workflows.
   

  

 Technical Risk Management: Identify integration, architecture, security and operational risks and drive mitigation before deployment.
   

  

 Fault Management Architecture: Design alarm/event flow from network element to SNOC including normalization, severity, correlation, suppression, raise/clear and auto\-ticketing.
   

  

 Performance Management Architecture: Define KPI/counter integration through Bulkstat, APIs, Prometheus, telemetry or other performance interfaces.
   

  

 Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC): Drive standardization, reusable integration patterns, architecture governance, FTR improvement, defect prevention and continuous engineering transformation to accelerate technology onboarding and improve overall SNOC operational excellence.
   

  

 Data Privacy \& Security Enforcement: Enforce secure\-by\-design practices across SNOC integrations, including RBAC, API/SNMP/Kafka security, data protection and controlled access to sensitive network data.
   

  

 HOTO \& Operational Readiness: Ensure complete integration evidence, monitoring coverage, testing results and operational acceptance before SNOC/COG handover
   

  

 Database \& Backup Governance: Ensure database integration, data consistency, backup validation and recovery readiness across SNOC ecosystem platforms.
   

  

 Automated Observability: Drive automation for integration validation, alarm testing, reconciliation, health checks and monitoring validation to improve FTR and reduce rework.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
* Overall Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of progressive, post\-qualification experience in Project and Telecom management.
* Leadership Experience: Proven track record in a senior operational or engineering leadership role managing large environments and leading regulatory/compliance audits.


**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**
* Applications \& Tools: OSS/NMS/EMS environment integration, HPSM(Service Manager). NNMi/Temip, NPM(Performance Management), UIM(Inventory), UHC, Prometheus, Syslog and end\-to\-end network management platforms.
* Containerisation \& Management: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP), Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Kubernetes, and CSI frameworks.
* Integration Interfaces: End\-to\-End integration architectures using Rest APIs, SNMP, MIB/OID, CLI, API, Kafka, Syslog, CLI, Telemetry, Webhooks and event\-driven interfaces.
* Networking \& Security: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cloud Native Core (CNE) technologies, and Ni7 architectures.
* Monitoring \& Observability: Automated monitoring and alerting platforms for real\-time performance degradation tracking and network fault isolation.
* Automation: API Automation, Python/Shell, Validation Scripts, Auto\-Ticketing, Health Checks.
* Data Protection: Applications \& tools and disaster recovery frameworks.
